live_evidence.title: Monetary policy decisions
live_evidence.notes: ECB first-party decision page states that all three key interest rates were raised by 25 basis points, to 2.50% for the deposit facility, 2.65% for main refinancing operations and 2.90% for the marginal lending facility, effective 16 September 2026. Exact publication time is supplied by the ECB's own press RSS item for this exact decision URL. Live evidence does not alter Canonical timing or provenance.

live_observation.headline: ECB raises all three key interest rates by 25 basis points
live_observation.summary: The European Central Bank announced on 10 September 2026 that the Governing Council raised all three key ECB interest rates by 25 basis points. The deposit facility rate, main refinancing operations rate and marginal lending facility rate will be 2.50%, 2.65% and 2.90% respectively from 16 September 2026. This observation records the official rate decision only; it does not encode staff projections, expectations, surprise, market reaction, press-conference interpretation or causal analysis.

scope_exclusions: ECB staff macroeconomic projections are not folded into this decision observation.
